service_boundary: Represents Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, not the Qwen model family, Qwen Chat, downloadable weights, or Alibaba Cloud's broader machine-learning platform.
regional_controls: Keys, endpoints, model availability, storage, and inference deployment are region-scoped. Alibaba documents China and international regions plus Global, US, and EU deployment scopes with model-specific availability.
retention_controls: Alibaba states Model Studio data is not used for model training; stored resources and playground history have feature-specific behavior and remain region-dependent.
routing: Customers select models and region-scoped endpoints; compatible protocols do not imply automatic cross-provider routing.
customization: The platform supports tuning, application building, and deployment paths for eligible models and customer artifacts.
strengths: Broad access to Qwen and other models through region-scoped cloud controls.
OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible protocols are documented.
tradeoffs: Model and feature availability vary substantially by region.
The platform's broad scope requires model-specific terms and deployment review.

response_integrity.note: No signature, attestation, or equivalent mechanism for verifying that a response arrived unaltered from the model appears in the API reference or the security documentation.
response_integrity.scope: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio documentation, for Alibaba Cloud Model Studio

upstream_disclosure.note: The Model Studio privacy notice states how the operator handles content: "Alibaba Cloud strictly protects your data privacy and will never use your data for model training." It does not say whether the publishers of third-party models hosted on the platform receive prompt content.
upstream_disclosure.scope: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio privacy notice, for Alibaba Cloud Model Studio

credential_handling.note: The service offers no customer-supplied-key path: keys are issued by Model Studio ("The plaintext key is displayed only once upon creation. It cannot be viewed again after the dialog box is closed. If lost, reset or create a new key.") and every documented request uses one.
credential_handling.scope: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio API-key guide, for Alibaba Cloud Model Studio

cache_isolation.note: The context-cache guide's FAQ states: "A: No. Both implicit cache and explicit cache data is isolated at the account level."
cache_isolation.scope: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio context-cache guide, for Alibaba Cloud Model Studio

vulnerability_disclosure.note: Alibaba's security response centre is the company-wide disclosure route: "ASRC(Alibaba Security Response Center) is the point of contact of Alibaba security." It does not name Model Studio.
vulnerability_disclosure.scope: Alibaba Security Response Center, for Alibaba Cloud Model Studio

independent_audit.note: The privacy notice names the service: "Alibaba Cloud Model Studio has achieved SOC 2 compliance with an unqualified opinion, validating its controls for Security, Availability, and Confidentiality."
independent_audit.scope: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio privacy notice, for Alibaba Cloud Model Studio
